about: Mod ping-pong round 5, batch 3 (docs/design/mod-pingpong.md#lote-3--compat-entre-sistemas-que-ya-tenemos): compat between systems the pack already has. Staging is by the round-5 family of tools/generate_family_balance.py (pingpong5compat): Advanced Peripherals' AE2 disk cells are removed (MEGA Cells, act IV, is the large-cell route).

apothic_compat: Cataclysm, Twilight Forest and Undergarden ranged weapons join Apotheosis's bow category
Affix loot for weapons Apotheosis 8 cannot categorise on its own; data map only
irons_apothic: Apotheosis affixes and gems for Iron's Spells gear
Follows Iron's act II entry and the campaign World Tiers; affix values native, to review in play
polyeng: Polymorph recipe choice inside AE2 pattern encoding
Resolves conflicting outputs in ME patterns the way Polymorph does at the crafting table
ad_astra_giselle_addon: Space protection upgrades for the MekaSuit and PneumaticCraft armour, fuel loader, rocket sensor and an automated NASA workbench
The automated workbench is made from the NASA workbench, whose atomic-alloy gate (Act V) stays the way into rockets
advancedperipherals: ComputerCraft peripherals: ME and RS bridges, detectors, inventory manager, chat box, geo scanner and automata turtles
Optional programming beside CC: Tweaked; its AE2 disk cells are removed, the chunky turtle is off, and the player detector and chat box are range-limited

cfRelations.why: CurseForge relates Advanced Peripherals and More Red CCT to CC: Tweaked's original project (282001); the lock carries CC: Tweaked 1.120.2 from project 1676502, which provides the same computercraft mod ID their mods.toml requires ([1.119.0,) and [1.114.4,))

Botarium is a stale CurseForge relation of Giselle 8.1: its mods.toml requires only ad_astra, common_storage_lib and resourcefulconfig (Ad Astra 1.16 moved from Botarium to Common Storage Lib), and ATM10 8.1 ships this file without Botarium
